purpose: Prevent false physical-habitat conclusions caused by treating two discordant published Ledda colony centroids as a unique historical nesting footprint.

fretwell_2021.meaning: Published colony site coordinates; NOT 2011 or 2014 verified breeding-patch polygons

predeclared_comparison.primary_coordinate_remains: larue_2024 as frozen in original PR195 ice-extraction contract; no post hoc change
predeclared_comparison.sensitivity_coordinate: fretwell_2021, independently sampled with exactly same dates and radii

decision_conditions.if_same_physical_classification: PASS_SPATIAL_CENTROID_ROBUSTNESS_ONLY; neither full-season viability nor breeding vacancy is verified

boundaries: The displacement of map coordinates is not evidence of true penguin migration or colony spatial movement
No newly founded colony, social choice, Allee effect, successful breeding, rescue, or causal mechanism is identified
The biological value is differentiating uncertain spatial support from genuine unused breeding space
Fretwell et al. and LaRue et al. coordinates may represent different detection, geocoding, or within-bay locations
Never alter frozen Ecology submission PR189, original PR195 single-coordinate receipts or the prior outcome-freeze
